tests.name: AT-01
tests.title: Legitimate password-reset notice
tests.summary: PASS - every model stayed below the abstain lower bound (0.38, 0.45). Absent from pass state: abstain thresholds are Rules 0.38-0.62 and TF-IDF LR / Third 0.45-0.55; PASS requires all model scores below the lower bound.
tests.input_message: Your password reset was completed by the service desk and the account review confirms no further action is required. Please keep this message for your records and contact support only if you expected a change to your account access.
tests.defanged_message: Your password reset was completed by the service desk and the account review confirms no further action is required[.] Please keep this message for your records and contact support only if you expected a change to your account access[.]

false_positive_impact.analyst_experience: Wasted triage minutes and alert fatigue from escalating legitimate urgent messages into human review.

tests.name: AT-02
tests.title: Unfamiliar phishing phrasing
tests.summary: The unseen campaign was caught by 2 model(s); 1 abstained and 0 missed.
tests.input_message: Tax or billing follow-up A recent account mismatch was flagged during the regular review cycle, and the access status still needs a final check before the update is cleared. Please review the current status and confirm the latest access note.
tests.defanged_message: Tax or billing follow-up A recent account mismatch was flagged during the regular review cycle, and the access status still needs a final check before the update is cleared[.] Please review the current status and confirm the latest access note[.]

tests.name: AT-03
tests.title: Defanged URL and punctuation changes
tests.summary: The model was materially sensitive to punctuation and URL formatting changes, which is a limitation in the current feature space.
tests.baseline_message: The password reset was completed and your security review is active. No further action is required and the service desk has already verified the request.
tests.perturbed_message: URGENT!!! Your password reset is pending and the account review requires confirmation now! Please verify hxxp://secure[.]portal[.]review/login before the security check closes.
tests.note: Model limitation: formatting changes such as URL defanging and punctuation materially shift the score, indicating surface-form sensitivity rather than robust semantic understanding.
